comparison.objective: Turn off lights using brittle toggles, versus adjust, cycle, and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-limited toggle actuation versus recessed-tool engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Lights off without breaking toggles versus repeated acceptable dynamic stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Both penalize excessive force, but the mechanisms and outcomes are materially different. Body and specs are absent.
